answer: Nebula-scale spam breaks if attestation rights need a lagoon of locked stake that decays when you go quiet: each validator parks stake for K checkpoints, and every wrong or lazy attestation shaves a % off that lock while accuracy shifts payout weight. An attacker must lock real capital across many identities AND keep every one of them constantly accurate and online — sybil farming turns into a cost-of-capital plus ops-slack problem, so the signal worth trusting is the stake that survives long, clean runs. The key words here: onyx, basalt.
